Refactor Settings page: extract components, move helpers to Core

- Extract reusable ToggleSwitch component \(replaces 8 inline toggles\)
- Extract reusable Modal component \(replaces 5 inline modals\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Refactor Settings page: extract Icons, edit panels; flatten styles

- Extract 27 inline SVGs into shared Icons.razor static component
- Extract CategoryEditPanel, DivisionEditPanel, EditPanelPlaceholder components
- Flatten all gradient CSS classes to flat equivalents
- Remove active:scale transform and unused GetStatusBadgeClassesCompact

Co-Authored-By: Claude \(claude-opus-4-6\) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
